let advanceTimer=null,notice='',wrongId='',roundsDone=0;
const KEY='neon.time-lab.cards.v1';
const ages=[['Palaeolithic',-2600000,-9701,0],['Mesolithic transition',-9700,-8001,0],['Neolithic communities',-8000,-4001,0],['Early cities & copper',-4000,-3301,1],['Bronze Age worlds',-3300,-1201,1],['Iron Age worlds',-1200,-501,1],['Classical antiquity',-500,249,2],['Late antiquity',250,600,2],['Early medieval worlds',601,999,2],['High medieval worlds',1000,1299,2],['Late medieval worlds',1300,1499,2],['Renaissance',1400,1600,3],['Oceanic encounters & empires',1450,1700,3],['Reformation & early modern states',1500,1649,3],['Scientific Revolution',1543,1687,3],['Enlightenment',1685,1789,3],['Atlantic revolutions',1760,1798,3],['Napoleonic era',1799,1815,4],['Industrial transformation',1760,1900,4],['Empires & reform',1816,1913,4],['First World War',1914,1918,4],['Interwar years',1919,1938,4],['Second World War',1939,1945.99,4],['Cold War & decolonisation',1946,1991,5],['Contemporary world',1992,2026,5]];
const topics=['World War II','World War I','Napoleonic Wars','Crusades','Space race','Printing & ideas','Revolutions','African kingdoms','Maya','Aztec','Inca','Mesopotamia','Persia','Byzantine','Islamic history','Ottoman','Industrial','Enlightenment','Climate diplomacy'];
let scopeP=false,diffP=false,viewP=false,catP=false,screen='home',age=null,century=null,view='Countries',pack='',cat='All',opened=null,mode='',difficulty='Easy',round=[],index=0,selected=[],answered=false,correct=false,finished=false,vault=false,opts=[],seen=[],cards=[],storageOK=true;
try{cards=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'[]');if(!Array.isArray(cards))cards=[];cards=cards.filter(id=>E.some(e=>e.id===id));localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(cards));}catch{storageOK=false;cards=[];}
const JOURNEYKEY='neon.time-lab.journey.v1';let journey='free',eraWins=[],rewardEra=null;
try{let j=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(JOURNEYKEY)||'{}');journey=j.mode==='chronological'?'chronological':'free';let n=0;while(Array.isArray(j.completed)&&j.completed.includes(n)&&n<25)n++;eraWins=Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>i);}catch{storageOK=false;}
function saveJourney(){try{localStorage.setItem(JOURNEYKEY,JSON.stringify({mode:journey,completed:eraWins}));}catch{storageOK=false;}}
function accessible(i){return journey==='free'||i===null||i<=eraWins.length;}
function setJourney(m){journey=m==='chronological'?'chronological':'free';rewardEra=null;saveJourney();library();}
function goTrail(){journey='chronological';saveJourney();rewardEra=null;vault=false;diffP=false;gEra(Math.min(24,eraWins.length));}
function goRoam(){journey='free';saveJourney();screen='roam';rewardEra=null;age=null;century=null;vault=false;reset();render();scrollTo(0,0);}
function goGames(){scopeP=true;diffP=false;screen='games';rewardEra=null;vault=false;reset();render();scrollTo(0,0);}
function gEra(i){scopeP=true;rewardEra=null;age=i<0?null:i;century=null;screen='games';reset();render();scrollTo(0,0);}
function trailEra(i){if(!accessible(i))return;gEra(i);}
function completeEra(){if(journey!=='chronological')return false;if(age===null||age!==eraWins.length)return false;if(!eraWins.includes(age)){eraWins.push(age);saveJourney();}rewardEra=age;clearTimeout(advanceTimer);mode='';render();scrollTo(0,0);return true;}
function nextEra(){let n=rewardEra+1;rewardEra=null;if(n<25)quickPlay(n);else library();}
function trophyShelf(){return '<h2>Era collectibles · '+eraWins.length+'/25</h2><p class="note">Finish an era round in Chronological mode to earn its guide robot. Quiz/Match: one full era-wide round of up to 6 cards. Timeline: put 3 events in order. Corrections count as learning, so no perfect score is needed.</p><div class="trophies">'+ages.map((a,i)=>'<article class="trophy '+(eraWins.includes(i)?'earned':'sealed')+'">'+(eraWins.includes(i)?img(PERIODART[i]):'<span class="sealedicon" aria-hidden="true">◇</span>')+'<strong>'+esc(a[0])+'</strong><small>'+(eraWins.includes(i)?'Guide collected':'Finish era '+(i+1))+'</small></article>').join('')+'</div>';}
const esc=s=>String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const q=s=>esc(JSON.stringify(s));
const img=i=>'<img class="pixelcharacter" src="'+CHARART[i]+'" alt="'+esc(CHARPLAN[i].role+' - '+CHARPLAN[i].name+' - fictional glossy-block robot guide')+'">';
const btn=(label,act,cls='',disabled=false)=>'<button class="'+cls+'" onclick="'+esc(act)+'" '+(disabled?'disabled':'')+'>'+label+'</button>';
function date(e){if(e.displayDate)return e.displayDate;if(e.title==='Pyramids rise at Giza')return '2600–2500 BCE';return Math.floor(Math.abs(e.year))+(e.year<0?' BCE':' CE');}
function topic(e,t){if(['African kingdoms','Maya','Aztec','Inca','Mesopotamia','Persia','Byzantine','Islamic history','Ottoman','Industrial','Enlightenment'].includes(t))return e.era===t;return t==='World War I'?e.era==='World War I'&&e.year>=1914&&e.year<=1918:t==='Climate diplomacy'?e.publisher==='United Nations':t==='World War II'?e.publisher==='US Holocaust Memorial Museum':t==='Napoleonic Wars'?e.country==='France'&&e.year>=1799&&e.year<=1815:t==='Crusades'?e.era==='Crusades':t==='Space race'?e.publisher==='Britannica space-race timeline':t==='Printing & ideas'?['Ideas','Inventions','Language','Education'].includes(e.category):e.category==='Revolutions';}
function base(){return E.filter(e=>century!==null?e.year>=century&&e.year<century+100:age===null||e.year>=ages[age][1]&&e.year<=ages[age][2]);}
function pool(){return base().filter(e=>!pack||(view==='Countries'?e.country===pack:topic(e,pack))).filter(e=>cat==='All'||e.category===cat);}
function artFor(e){return (age!==null?PERIODEVENT[age+'|'+e.id]:undefined)??EVENTART[e.id]??0;}
function story(e){return '<div class="eyebrow">'+esc(e.category)+' · '+esc(e.country)+'</div><div class="storyhead">'+img(artFor(e))+'<h2>'+esc(e.title)+'</h2></div><p class="story">'+esc(e.story)+'</p><div class="outcome"><strong>What changed</strong><p>'+esc(e.result)+'</p></div><a class="sourcebtn" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="'+esc(e.source)+'">'+esc(e.publisher)+'</a>';}
function unlock(es){cards=[...new Set([...cards,...es.map(e=>e.id)])];try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(cards));}catch{storageOK=false;}}
function shuffle(a){a=a.slice();for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){let j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]];}return a;}
function reset(){clearTimeout(advanceTimer);mode='';pack='';cat='All';catP=false;opened=null;}
function library(){scopeP=false;diffP=false;viewP=false;catP=false;rewardEra=null;age=null;century=null;vault=false;screen='home';reset();render();scrollTo(0,0);}
function pickAge(i){if(!accessible(i))return;rewardEra=null;age=i;century=null;screen='roam';reset();render();scrollTo(0,0);}
function pickCentury(c){if(journey==='chronological')return;century=c;age=Math.max(0,ages.findIndex(a=>c>=a[1]&&c<=a[2]));reset();render();scrollTo(0,0);}
function setView(v){viewP=true;catP=false;view=v;pack='';cat='All';opened=null;render();}
function setPack(p){catP=false;pack=p;cat='All';opened=null;render();scrollTo(0,0);}
function setCat(c){catP=true;cat=c;opened=null;render();}
function openStory(id){opened=E.find(e=>e.id===id);render();}
function saveStory(){unlock([opened]);render();}
function showVault(){clearTimeout(advanceTimer);vault=true;render();scrollTo(0,0);}
function backVault(){vault=false;render();scrollTo(0,0);}
function prepare(){let e=round[index],p=pool();opts=shuffle(p.filter(x=>x.id!==e.id&&(mode!=='People match'||x.person!==e.person))).filter((x,i,a)=>mode!=='People match'||a.findIndex(y=>y.person===x.person)===i).slice(0,difficulty==='Easy'?2:3);opts=shuffle([...opts,e]);}
function resumePlay(){if(journey==='chronological'){quickPlay(Math.min(24,eraWins.length));return;}let saved;try{saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('neon.time-lab.last-period.v1'));}catch{}let i=saved&&Number.isInteger(saved.age)&&saved.age>=0&&saved.age<25?saved.age:0;pickAge(i);start(saved&&['Quiz','People match','Timeline'].includes(saved.mode)?saved.mode:'Quiz');}
function quickPlay(i){if(!accessible(i))return;age=i;century=null;screen='games';reset();start('Quiz');}
function start(m){if(!accessible(age))return;if(!gOpen(m,difficulty))difficulty=gTop(m);roundRight=0;rewardEra=null;if(journey==='chronological'){pack='';cat='All';century=null;view='Countries';}try{localStorage.setItem('neon.time-lab.last-period.v1',JSON.stringify({age,mode:m}));}catch{}clearTimeout(advanceTimer);notice='';wrongId='';let p=pool(),fresh=p.filter(e=>!seen.includes(e.id));if(!fresh.length){fresh=p;seen=[];}round=shuffle(fresh).slice(0,m==='Timeline'?3:Math.min(6,fresh.length));if(m!=='Timeline')round.sort((x,y)=>x.year-y.year);seen=[...seen,...round.map(e=>e.id)];selected=[];answered=false;mode=m;index=0;finished=false;opened=null;prepare();render();scrollTo(0,0);}
function answer(id){if(answered)return;correct=id===round[index].id;if(correct)roundRight++;gMsg='';answered=true;wrongId=correct?'':id;notice=correct?'Good job':(mode==='People match'?round[index].person:round[index].title+' · '+date(round[index]));unlock([round[index]]);render();advanceTimer=setTimeout(next,correct?900:2600);} 
function next(){clearTimeout(advanceTimer);notice='';wrongId='';if(index+1===round.length){roundsDone++;gRec(mode,round.length);if(!completeEra())start(mode);return;}index++;answered=false;selected=[];prepare();render();scrollTo(0,0);}
function select(id){if(answered||selected.includes(id))return;let pending=round.filter(e=>!selected.includes(e.id)).sort((a,b)=>a.year-b.year),expected=pending[0];correct=round.find(e=>e.id===id).year===expected.year;if(correct)roundRight++;gMsg='';answered=true;wrongId=correct?'':id;notice=correct?'Good job':'Next: '+expected.title+' · '+date(expected);selected.push(correct?id:expected.id);render();advanceTimer=setTimeout(()=>{answered=false;notice='';wrongId='';if(selected.length===round.length){unlock(round);roundsDone++;gRec('Timeline',round.length);if(!completeEra())start('Timeline');}else render();},correct?650:2600);}
function check(){correct=selected.every((id,i)=>!i||round.find(e=>e.id===selected[i-1]).year<=round.find(e=>e.id===id).year);if(correct)unlock(round);render();}
function outfit(){let i=age===null?0:ages[age][3];let p=PAProfile.load();let g=PAProfile.pixelGrid(p);let colours=['#ae8dd5','#f9e8bc','#9dacbf','#874bbf','#344d77','#a2efe8'];let cloth=colours[i];for(let y=20;y<28;y++)for(let x=5;x<=18;x++){g[y][x]=cloth;if(i===0&&(x===6||x===17)&&y%2===0)g[y][x]='#71619e';if(i===1&&y===23)g[y][x]=p.accentHex;if(i===2){if(y%3===0)g[y][x]='#526d86';if(x===11||x===12)g[y][x]=p.accentHex;}if(i===3&&(x===10||x===13))g[y][x]=p.accentHex;if(i===4&&x===11)g[y][x]=p.accentHex;if(i===5&&y===22)g[y][x]=p.accentHex;}
let canvas=document.getElementById('avatar');if(!canvas)return;let ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');ctx.clearRect(0,0,120,140);g.forEach((r,y)=>r.forEach((c,x)=>{if(c){ctx.fillStyle=c;ctx.fillRect(x*5,y*5,5,5);}}));}

else{let cats=[...new Set(base().filter(e=>view==='Countries'?e.country===pack:topic(e,pack)).map(e=>e.category))].sort();s+='<h2>Sub-folders</h2><div class="chips">'+['All',...cats].map(c=>btn(esc(c),'setCat('+JSON.stringify(c)+')',catP&&cat===c?'chosen':'')).join('')+'</div>';
if(opened)s+='<article class="event">'+btn('Close story','opened=null;render()')+'<p class="badge">'+esc(date(opened))+'</p>'+story(opened)+btn(cards.includes(opened.id)?'Collected':'Save this card','saveStory()','launch')+'</article>';else s+='<h2>Stories in this folder</h2><div class="eventlist">'+p.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.year-b.year).map(x=>btn('<span>'+esc(date(x))+'</span><strong>'+esc(x.title)+'</strong><small>'+esc(x.category)+' · '+(cards.includes(x.id)?'collected':'open story')+'</small>','openStory('+JSON.stringify(x.id)+')')).join('')+'</div>';}}
else{s+='<section class="game compact"><div class="modebar">'+['Quiz','People match','Timeline'].map(m=>btn(m==='People match'?'Match':m,'start('+JSON.stringify(m)+')',mode===m?'chosen':'')).join('')+'</div><div class="miniprogress"><span>'+(age===null?'All of history':esc(ages[age][0]))+'</span><strong>'+(mode==='Timeline'?selected.length+' / '+round.length:(index+1)+' / '+round.length)+'</strong></div><div class="progressline"><span style="width:'+((mode==='Timeline'?selected.length:index)/round.length*100)+'%"></span></div><div class="smallguide">'+img(artFor(e))+'<canvas id="avatar" width="120" height="140" aria-label="Your shared Arcade avatar"></canvas><div><h1>'+(mode==='Timeline'?'Earliest to latest':mode==='People match'?'Who fits the story?':'Find the event')+'</h1><p>'+(mode==='Timeline'?'Tap the next event.':difficulty+' · '+mode)+'</p></div></div>';

else{let clue=mode==='People match'?e.story.replace(new RegExp(e.person.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&'),'gi'),'the figure'):clMask(e.story,clWords(e.title));s+='<div class="question"><div class="eyebrow">'+esc(e.category)+' · '+esc(e.country)+'</div><p class="story">'+esc(clue)+'</p><div class="answers">'+opts.map(x=>btn(esc(mode==='People match'?x.person:difficulty==='Easy'?x.title:difficulty==='Medium'?date(x)+' · '+x.title:x.result),'answer('+JSON.stringify(x.id)+')',(wrongId===x.id?'wrong ':answered&&x.id===e.id?'right ':''),answered)).join('')+'</div></div>';}

/* ===== Clue ladder + difficulty gating (private preview) ===== */
const GKEY='neon.time-lab.gates.v1',CL_PASS=0.8;let G={},gMsg='',roundRight=0;
try{G=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(GKEY)||'{}')||{};}catch{G={};}
function gSave(){try{localStorage.setItem(GKEY,JSON.stringify(G));}catch{}}
function gCnt(m,d){return G[m+'|'+d]||0;}
function gOpen(m,d){return d==='Easy'||(d==='Medium'&&gCnt(m,'Easy')>=3)||(d==='Hard'&&gCnt(m,'Medium')>=3);}
function gTop(m){return gOpen(m,'Hard')?'Hard':gOpen(m,'Medium')?'Medium':'Easy';}
function gNeed(d){return d==='Medium'?'Easy':'Medium';}
function gRec(m,n){const need=Math.ceil(n*CL_PASS);if(roundRight>=need){const was=gOpen(m,'Medium'),wasH=gOpen(m,'Hard');G[m+'|'+difficulty]=gCnt(m,difficulty)+1;gSave();gMsg='Last round cleared: '+(m==='People match'?'Match':m)+' '+difficulty+' '+Math.min(3,gCnt(m,difficulty))+'/3.'+(!was&&gOpen(m,'Medium')?' Medium unlocked!':!wasH&&gOpen(m,'Hard')?' Hard unlocked!':'');}else gMsg='Last round not cleared ('+roundRight+'/'+n+', need '+need+'). '+(m==='People match'?'Match':m)+' '+difficulty+' '+Math.min(3,gCnt(m,difficulty))+'/3.';}
function gNote(){const L=['Timeline','People match','Quiz'].filter(m=>!gOpen(m,difficulty)).map(m=>(m==='People match'?'Match':m)+': clear '+gNeed(difficulty)+' 3 times ('+Math.min(3,gCnt(m,gNeed(difficulty)))+'/3)');return '<p class="note">Clear = '+Math.round(CL_PASS*100)+'% right in a round. 3 clears of a level unlock the next, per game.'+(L.length?'<br>🔒 '+L.join(' · '):'')+'</p>';}
/* ---- Clue ladder ---- */
const CL={on:false,scr:'menu',topic:'Event',sub:'mc',qs:[],i:0,t0:0,pen:0,found:0,score:0,done:false,msg:'',timer:null,adv:null,off:[],last:-1,res:''};
const PBAD=/people|peoples|scribes|workers|farmers|communit|societ|traders|citizens|armies|soldiers|settlers|builders|artists|merchants|several|various|rulers|scholars|many|forces|athletes|hoplites|crusaders|^athens|\band\b|allied|alliance|coalition|workers|ironworkers/i;
function clBase(){const p=pool();return p.length>=6?p:(base().length>=6?base():E);}
function clScope(){if(age===null&&!pack)return 'all periods';const p=pool();return p.length>=6?'this folder':base().length>=6?'this era':'all periods';}
function clAges(e){return ages.map((a,i)=>[a,i]).filter(([a])=>e.year>=a[1]&&e.year<=a[2]).sort((x,y)=>(x[0][2]-x[0][1])-(y[0][2]-y[0][1])).map(([a,i])=>i);}
function clCt(e){return e.country==='Regional'?'Cross-border history':e.country+' (modern name)';}
function clNorm(s){return String(s).toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').replace(/[^a-z0-9 ]+/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();}
function clMask(txt,terms){let o=txt;terms.filter(t=>t&&t.length>2).sort((a,b)=>b.length-a.length).forEach(t=>{o=o.replace(new RegExp('\\b'+t.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&')+'\\w*','gi'),'▢▢▢');});return o;}
const CLSTOP=new Set(['the','and','of','in','to','a','an','for','from','with','begins','begin','rise','rises','falls','fall','war']);
function clWords(s){return clNorm(s).split(' ').filter(w=>w.length>3&&!CLSTOP.has(w));}
function clBuild(e,topic){const era=ages[clAges(e)[0]??0][0],d=date(e);
 if(topic==='Person'){const t=[e.person,...e.person.split(/\s+/)].concat(clWords(e.title).slice(0,0));const mk=s=>clMask(s,t);return{ans:e.person,alias:e.person.split(/\s+/).filter(w=>w.length>3&&!/^(the|great|king|queen|saint)$/i.test(w)),lab:'Who is it?',clues:[era+' · '+e.category,clCt(e),mk(e.story),mk(e.result),'Event: '+clMask(e.title,t)+' · '+d+' · starts with “'+e.person.slice(0,2)+'”']};}
 if(topic==='Period'){const t=clWords(era);const mk=s=>clMask(s,t);return{ans:era,ok:clAges(e).map(i=>ages[i][0]),lab:'Which period?',clues:[e.category,clCt(e),mk(e.story),mk(e.result),d+' · '+e.title]};}
 const t=clWords(e.title);const mk=s=>clMask(s,t);return{ans:e.title,tw:t,lab:'Which event?',clues:[e.category+' · '+era,clCt(e),mk(e.story),mk(e.result),d+' · starts with “'+e.title.slice(0,3)+'”']};}
function clMake(topic){let pool0=clBase();if(topic==='Person'){const seenP=new Set();pool0=pool0.filter(e=>e.person&&!PBAD.test(e.person)&&!seenP.has(e.person)&&seenP.add(e.person));if(pool0.length<6){const s2=new Set();pool0=E.filter(e=>e.person&&!PBAD.test(e.person)&&!s2.has(e.person)&&s2.add(e.person));}}
 const qs=shuffle(pool0).slice(0,10).map(e=>{const q=clBuild(e,topic);q.e=e;let opts;if(topic==='Period'){const okI=clAges(e);const others=ages.map((a,i)=>i).filter(i=>!okI.includes(i));opts=shuffle([ages[okI[0]??0][0],...shuffle(others).slice(0,5).map(i=>ages[i][0])]);}
 else if(topic==='Person'){const ps=[...new Set(E.filter(x=>x.person&&!PBAD.test(x.person)&&x.person!==e.person).map(x=>x.person))];const near=shuffle(ps.filter(p=>E.some(x=>x.person===p&&x.country===e.country))).slice(0,3);const rest=shuffle(ps.filter(p=>!near.includes(p)));opts=shuffle([e.person,...[...near,...rest].slice(0,5)]);}
 else{const ts=E.filter(x=>x.id!==e.id);const near=shuffle(ts.filter(x=>x.category===e.category||x.country===e.country)).slice(0,3);const rest=shuffle(ts.filter(x=>!near.includes(x)));opts=shuffle([e.title,...[...near,...rest].slice(0,5).map(x=>x.title)]);}
 q.opts=opts;return q;});return qs;}
function clGood(q,txt){const n=clNorm(txt);if(!n)return false;if(clNorm(q.ans)===n)return true;if(q.ok&&q.ok.some(a=>clNorm(a)===n))return true;if(q.alias&&q.alias.some(a=>clNorm(a)===n))return true;if(q.tw&&q.tw.length){const got=q.tw.filter(w=>n.split(' ').includes(w)).length;return got>=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(q.tw.length*0.6));}return false;}

('+Math.min(3,G[k])+'/3)':'')+'.'+(CL.sub==='mc'&&!wasOpen&&clOpenSub(CL.topic)?' if(name==='trail'){[[2,13],[4,11],[6,10],[8,8],[10,6],[12,4]].forEach(q=>{rr(q[0],q[1],q[0]+1,q[1]+1,'#85f0c3');});rr(12,1,12,3,'#cfd8ea');rr(13,1,15,2,'#b18cff');}
else if(name==='roam'){for(let a=0;a<16;a++)for(let b=0;b<16;b++){const d=Math.hypot(a+.5-8,b+.5-8);if(d>=5.5&&d<=6.5)px(a,b,'#85f0c3');}rr(7,3,8,7,'#b18cff');rr(7,8,8,11,'#cfd8ea');rr(7,7,8,8,'#ffd76a');}
else{rr(4,4,11,11,'#7f6ae0');rr(4,4,11,4,'#a984ff');rr(4,4,4,11,'#a984ff');[[6,6],[9,6],[7,7],[8,8],[6,9],[9,9]].forEach(q=>px(q[0],q[1],'#85f0c3'));}
DUHICONS[name]=cv.toDataURL();return DUHICONS[name];}

const duS3=(g,x,y,c)=>{if(x>=0&&x<96&&y>=0&&y<128)g[y][x]=c;};
const duR3=(g,x0,y0,x1,y1,c)=>{for(let y=y0;y<=y1;y++)for(let x=x0;x<=x1;x++)duS3(g,x,y,c);};
const duS2=(g,x,y,c)=>{duS3(g,x*2,y*2,c);duS3(g,x*2+1,y*2,c);duS3(g,x*2,y*2+1,c);duS3(g,x*2+1,y*2+1,c);};
const duR2=(g,x0,y0,x1,y1,c)=>{for(let y=y0;y<=y1;y++)for(let x=x0;x<=x1;x++)duS2(g,x,y,c);};
const duS=(g,x,y,c)=>{duS2(g,x*2,y*2,c);duS2(g,x*2+1,y*2,c);duS2(g,x*2,y*2+1,c);duS2(g,x*2+1,y*2+1,c);};
const duR=(g,x0,y0,x1,y1,c)=>{for(let y=y0;y<=y1;y++)for(let x=x0;x<=x1;x++)duS(g,x,y,c);};
function duUp(c){const g=[];for(let y=0;y<128;y++){g.push(new Array(96).fill(null));for(let x=0;x<96;x++)g[y][x]=c[y>>2][x>>2];}return g;}

function duItem(id){return DUITEMS.find(i=>i.id===id);}
function duSil(){const c=[];for(let y=0;y<32;y++)c.push(new Array(24).fill(null));for(let y=3;y<=13;y++)for(let x=6;x<=17;x++){const dx=(x+.5-12)/6.2,dy=(y+.5-8.5)/5.6;if(dx*dx+dy*dy<=1)c[y][x]='#2c3a58';}for(let y=15;y<=30;y++)for(let x=6;x<=17;x++)c[y][x]='#2c3a58';for(let y=29;y<=31;y++){c[y][11]='#1c2740';c[y][12]='#1c2740';}return duUp(c);}
function duDrawGrid(cv,g,scale){const ctx=cv.getContext('2d');ctx.clearRect(0,0,cv.width,cv.height);g.forEach((r,y)=>r.forEach((c,x)=>{if(c){ctx.fillStyle=c;ctx.fillRect(x*scale,y*scale,scale,scale);}}));}
const DUICONS={};
function duDetail(id,g){const H=(x,y,c)=>duS2(g,x,y,c);const R=(x,y)=>g[y*2]&&g[y*2][x*2];
switch(id){
case 'yuanlingpao':{for(let y=44;y<=60;y++){H(22,y,'#46588c');H(25,y,'#46588c');}for(let x=18;x<=29;x++){H(x,44,'#5a6fa0');}for(let x=11;x<=36;x+=2){H(x,60,'#2c3a60');}H(21,42,'#5a6fa0');H(26,42,'#5a6fa0');break;}
case 'futou':{duS2(g,12,4,null);duS2(g,13,4,null);duS2(g,34,4,null);duS2(g,35,4,null);duS2(g,12,5,null);duS2(g,35,5,null);for(let x=15;x<=22;x++)H(x,6,'#2c2c38');H(14,7,'#2c2c38');break;}
case 'nemes':{for(let y=2;y<=17;y+=4){for(let x=12;x<=35;x++)if(R(x,y+1)==='#d9a441')H(x,y+1,'#e8b85a');}for(let y=8;y<=27;y++){if(R(8,y)==='#d9a441'||R(8,y)==='#2e4b9b')H(8,y,'#1f3560');if(R(39,y)==='#d9a441'||R(39,y)==='#2e4b9b')H(39,y,'#1f3560');}break;}
case 'wig':{for(const x of[12,16,20,28,32])for(let y=8;y<=18;y++)if(R(x,y)==='#15151d')H(x,y,'#3a3a4d');break;}
case 'wesekh':{for(let x=16;x<=31;x+=2){if(R(x,38))H(x,38,'#f4e3b0');}break;}
case 'petasos':{for(let x=7;x<=40;x++)if(R(x,8)==='#b08d57')H(x,8,'#c9a86e');break;}
case 'chiton':{H(11,41,'#d9a441');H(12,41,'#d9a441');H(35,41,'#d9a441');H(36,41,'#d9a441');for(let y=50;y<=54;y++){H(21,y,'#cfc4a8');H(29,y,'#cfc4a8');}break;}
case 'coif':case 'hauberk':case 'chausses':{for(let y=0;y<64;y++)for(let x=0;x<48;x++)if(R(x,y)==='#9aa3ad'&&(x+y)%4===1)H(x,y,'#7d8692');break;}
case 'jadebelt':{for(const x of[16,22,24,30]){H(x,46,'#b8ecc9');H(x+1,46,'#b8ecc9');}break;}
case 'tangboots':{for(const x0 of[12,28])for(let x=x0;x<=x0+5;x++)H(x,60,'#3d3d4d');break;}
case 'correspondent':{for(const x0 of[12,28])for(let x=x0+1;x<=x0+4;x++)H(x,61,'#f4f0e4');break;}
case 'tuxedo':{for(let y=40;y<=46;y++){H(22,y,'#e8e4d8');H(25,y,'#e8e4d8');}H(23,42,'#191920');H(24,42,'#191920');break;}
case 'kataginu':{for(let y=40;y<=47;y++){H(4,y,'#8c2b20');H(43,y,'#8c2b20');}break;}
}}
function duDetail2(id,g){
switch(id){
case 'coif':case 'hauberk':case 'chausses':{for(let y=1;y<128;y+=4)for(let x=2;x<96;x+=4)if(g[y][x]==='#9aa3ad')duS3(g,x,y,'#aab3bd');for(let y=3;y<128;y+=4)for(let x=0;x<96;x+=4)if(g[y][x]==='#9aa3ad')duS3(g,x,y,'#5f6873');break;}
case 'wesekh':{for(let x=32;x<=63;x+=4){if(g[77][x]){duS3(g,x,77,'#f7ecc8');duS3(g,x+1,77,'#f7ecc8');}if(g[81][x])duS3(g,x,81,'#f7ecc8');}break;}
case 'yuanlingpao':{for(let y=88;y<=121;y++){duS3(g,45,y,'#2c3a60');duS3(g,50,y,'#5a6fa0');}break;}
case 'wig':{for(let x=24;x<=72;x+=8)for(let y=16;y<=36;y++){if(g[y][x]==='#15151d')duS3(g,x,y,'#3a3a4d');if(g[y][x+2]==='#15151d')duS3(g,x+2,y,'#0a0a10');}break;}
case 'nemes':{for(const y of[9,17,25,33])for(let x=24;x<=71;x++)if(g[y][x]==='#2e4b9b')duS3(g,x,y,'#3d5fb0');break;}
case 'petasos':{for(let x=12;x<=83;x++)if(g[22][x]==='#8a6a3c')duS3(g,x,22,'#6e5330');break;}
case 'chiton':{for(let y=96;y<=110;y++){duS3(g,44,y,'#cfc4a8');duS3(g,60,y,'#cfc4a8');}break;}
case 'tangboots':{for(const x0 of[26,58])for(let x=x0;x<=x0+12;x+=2)duS3(g,x,121,'#3d3d4d');break;}
}}
function duIcon(id){if(DUICONS[id])return DUICONS[id];const it=duItem(id);const g=duSil();it.paint(g,null);duDetail(id,g);duDetail2(id,g);const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=288;cv.height=384;duDrawGrid(cv,g,3);DUICONS[id]=cv.toDataURL();return DUICONS[id];}
const DUTHUMBS={};
function duThumb(id){if(DUTHUMBS[id])return DUTHUMBS[id];const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=192;cv.height=224;const x=cv.getContext('2d');const px=(gx,gy,c)=>{x.fillStyle=c;x.fillRect(gx*3,gy*3+20,3,3);};const rr=(x0,y0,x1,y1,c)=>{for(let yy=y0;yy<=y1;yy++)for(let xx=x0;xx<=x1;xx++)px(xx,yy,c);};
if(id==='egypt'){rr(28,4,35,12,'#d9a441');for(let y=20;y<=48;y++){const w=(y-16)>>2;for(let xx=32-w;xx<=32+w;xx++)px(xx,y,xx<=32?'#d9c58f':'#b3a06a');if(y%8===0)for(let xx=32-w;xx<=32+w;xx++)px(xx,y,'#a08d5a');}}
else if(id==='athens'){rr(16,4,47,8,'#e8e4d8');for(let y=12;y<=40;y++){px(20,y,'#e8e4d8');px(28,y,'#e8e4d8');px(36,y,'#e8e4d8');px(44,y,'#e8e4d8');}rr(16,44,47,48,'#e8e4d8');}
else if(id==='tang'){rr(28,4,35,8,'#191920');rr(20,12,43,12,'#c0392b');rr(16,16,47,32,'#c0392b');rr(16,20,16,28,'#a02e22');rr(47,20,47,28,'#a02e22');rr(20,36,43,36,'#c0392b');rr(28,40,35,40,'#191920');rr(28,44,35,48,'#d9a441');rr(24,52,39,52,'#d9a441');}
else if(id==='knight'){for(let y=8;y<=36;y++)for(let xx=12;xx<=51;xx++)px(xx,y,'#3d7ddb');rr(12,40,43,40,'#3d7ddb');rr(20,44,35,44,'#3d7ddb');rr(28,48,31,48,'#3d7ddb');rr(28,8,35,44,'#d9a441');rr(12,20,51,24,'#d9a441');}
else if(id==='edo'){rr(12,8,51,8,'#c0392b');rr(8,12,55,12,'#c0392b');rr(16,28,47,28,'#c0392b');rr(16,16,23,52,'#c0392b');rr(40,16,47,52,'#c0392b');rr(28,16,35,24,'#c0392b');}
else if(id==='regency'){rr(16,40,47,48,'#d9a441');rr(16,28,23,36,'#d9a441');rr(28,24,35,36,'#d9a441');rr(40,28,47,36,'#d9a441');px(24,36,'#d9a441');px(36,36,'#d9a441');px(20,44,'#85f0c3');px(32,44,'#85f0c3');px(40,44,'#85f0c3');}
else{rr(40,8,47,40,'#85f0c3');rr(44,8,55,16,'#85f0c3');rr(28,40,43,52,'#85f0c3');rr(24,44,31,48,'#85f0c3');}
DUTHUMBS[id]=cv.toDataURL();return DUTHUMBS[id];}
function duChoices(mid,slot){const key=mid+'|'+slot;if(DU.optCache[key])return DU.optCache[key];const m=DUMISSIONS.find(x=>x.id===mid);const right=m.slots[slot];const wrong=shuffle(DUITEMS.filter(i=>i.slot===slot&&i.id!==right)).slice(0,2).map(i=>i.id);const all=shuffle([right,...wrong]);DU.optCache[key]=all;return all;}
function duRandMission(){const ids=DUMISSIONS.map(x=>x.id).filter(id=>id!==DU.last);return ids[Math.floor(Math.random()*ids.length)];}
function duOpen(){clStop();DU.on=true;DU.last=null;const id=duRandMission();DU.last=id;duMission(id);}
function duNew(){const id=duRandMission();DU.last=id;duMission(id);}
function duBack(){DU.on=false;DU.scr='menu';DU.mid=null;DU.slot=null;DU.picks={};DU.res=null;render();scrollTo(0,0);}
function duLib(){DU.on=false;duReadEra=null;library();}
function duGames(){DU.on=false;goGames();}
function duMission(id){DU.mid=id;DU.scr='play';DU.slot=null;DU.picks={};DU.res=null;DU.optCache={};render();scrollTo(0,0);}
function duSlot(slot){DU.slot=DU.slot===slot?null:slot;render();}
function duChoose(id){if(!DU.slot)return;DU.picks[DU.slot]=id;DU.slot=null;DU.res=null;render();}
function duCheck(){const m=DUMISSIONS.find(x=>x.id===DU.mid);let n=0;const rows=m.order.map(slot=>{const right=m.slots[slot];const pick=DU.picks[slot];const ok=pick===right;if(ok)n++;return{slot,ok,pick,right};});DU.res={stars:n,total:m.order.length,rows};if(!DUBEST[m.id]||n>DUBEST[m.id]){DUBEST[m.id]=n;duSave();}DU.scr='res';render();scrollTo(0,0);}
function duAgain(){DU.scr='play';DU.slot=null;DU.picks={};DU.res=null;DU.optCache={};render();scrollTo(0,0);}
function duPaintAvatar(){const cv=document.getElementById('ducanvas');if(!cv)return;let p=null;try{p=window.PAProfile&&PAProfile.load?PAProfile.load():null;}catch(e){p=null;}let b=null;if(window.PAProfile&&PAProfile.pixelGrid&&p){try{b=PAProfile.pixelGrid(p);}catch(e){b=null;}}let c=null;
if(b&&b.length===28){c=[];for(let y=0;y<32;y++)c.push(new Array(24).fill(null));for(let y=0;y<24;y++)for(let x=0;x<24;x++)c[y][x]=b[y][x];for(let y=24;y<28;y++){for(let x=5;x<=18;x++)c[y][x]=b[23][x];for(let x=5;x<=18;x++)c[y+4][x]=b[y][x];}for(let y=22;y<=25;y++)for(const x of[3,4,19,20]){const cc=b[y][x];c[y][x]=(DU.picks.top&&p&&p.skinHex&&cc!==p.skinHex)?null:cc;}}
else if(b&&b.length===32)c=b.map(r=>r.slice());
const g=c?duUp(c):duSil();
const m=DUMISSIONS.find(x=>x.id===DU.mid);if(m){if(m.base)m.base(g,p);if(DU.picks.head&&p&&p.hairHex&&!duItem(DU.picks.head).keepHair){const shfn=window.PAProfile&&PAProfile.shade?PAProfile.shade:(c=>c);const hs=[p.hairHex,shfn(p.hairHex,1.4),shfn(p.hairHex,.7)];for(let yy=0;yy<128;yy++)for(let xx=0;xx<96;xx++){if(hs.indexOf(g[yy][xx])>=0)g[yy][xx]=DUHAIR;}}
const order=['bottom','top','feet','head','extra'];order.forEach(slot=>{const id=DU.picks[slot];if(id){duItem(id).paint(g,p);duDetail(id,g);duDetail2(id,g);}});const sk2=p&&p.skinHex?p.skinHex:'#e0b89a';for(let yy=0;yy<128;yy++)for(let xx=0;xx<96;xx++){if(g[yy][xx]===DUHAIR){const dx=(xx/4+.5-12)/9,dy=(yy/4+.5-11.5)/7.7;g[yy][xx]=(dx*dx+dy*dy<=1)?sk2:null;}}}duDrawGrid(cv,g,7);}
function duDraw(){let s='<header class="top">'+btn('◀ Back','duBack()','navbtn')+'<a class="navbtn arcadebtn" href="../pixel-arcade/?v=history519">◀ Pixel Arcade</a>'+btn('◀ Home','duLib()','navbtn cardsbtn')+'</header><div class="brand">NEON <span>TIME LAB</span><small>Dress the era</small></div>';
if(DU.scr==='menu'){s+='<section class="playbar"><h2>Dress the era</h2><p class="note">Pick a mission. Dress your character in a documented outfit for that time, place and occasion. Tap a row, then tap an item to put it on. No timer: look, try, and learn. Each mission is one outfit backed by its sources - people had choices then, too.</p><div class="grid">'+DUMISSIONS.map(m=>{const best=DUBEST[m.id]||0,total=m.order.length;return btn('<img class="duthumb" src="'+duThumb(m.id)+'" alt="The outfit for this mission"><strong>'+esc(m.occasion)+'</strong><small>'+esc(m.place)+' · '+esc(m.when)+'</small><small>'+(best?'Best: '+'★'.repeat(Math.round(5*best/total))+'☆'.repeat(5-Math.round(5*best/total)):'Not tried yet')+'</small>','duMission('+JSON.stringify(m.id)+')','tile');}).join('')+'</div></section>';}
else{const m=DUMISSIONS.find(x=>x.id===DU.mid);s+='<section class="playbar"><div class="eyebrow">'+esc(m.place)+' · '+esc(m.when)+'</div><h2>'+esc(m.occasion)+'</h2><p class="note">'+esc(m.intro)+'</p>';
s+='<div class="duhero"><canvas id="ducanvas" width="672" height="896" aria-label="Your character wearing your picks"></canvas><div>'+(DU.scr==='res'?'<div class="dustars">'+'★'.repeat(Math.round(5*DU.res.stars/DU.res.total))+'☆'.repeat(5-Math.round(5*DU.res.stars/DU.res.total))+'</div><p>'+(DU.res.stars===DU.res.total?'Good job! A perfect outfit.':DU.res.stars===0?'No piece fits this time and place yet. Read the notes and try again.':'Almost there. Check the notes below.')+'</p>':'<p class="note">'+Object.keys(DU.picks).length+' / '+m.order.length+' picked</p>')+'</div></div>';
if(DU.scr==='res'){s+=DU.res.rows.map(r=>{const slot=DUSLOTS[r.slot];if(r.ok){const it=duItem(r.right);return '<div class="dufb good"><strong>'+esc(slot)+':</strong> <span>'+esc(it.name)+'. Good job! '+esc(it.fact)+'</span></div>';}const pk=duItem(r.pick),it=duItem(r.right);return '<div class="dufb bad"><strong>'+esc(slot)+':</strong> <span>'+esc(pk.name)+(pk.origin===m.origin?' belongs to this era, but not to this occasion and role.':' is '+esc(pk.origin==='modern times'?'from modern times':'from '+pk.origin)+' — not this time and place.')+' Right choice: '+esc(it.name)+'. '+esc(it.fact)+'</span></div>';}).join('');
s+='<p class="note">Read more: <a class="sourcebtn" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="'+esc(m.src)+'">'+esc(m.srcLabel)+'</a>'+(m.src2?' &middot; <a class="sourcebtn" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="'+esc(m.src2)+'">'+esc(m.src2Label)+'</a>':'')+'</p>';
s+='<div class="chips eqrow" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))">'+btn('Try again','duAgain()','launch')+btn('New character','duNew()')+btn('All games','duGames()')+'</div>';}
else{s+=m.order.map(slot=>{const pick=DU.picks[slot];let row=btn('<span><strong>'+DUSLOTS[slot]+'</strong><br><small>'+(pick?esc(duItem(pick).name):'Tap to choose')+'</small></span>'+(pick?'<img class="duicon" src="'+duIcon(pick)+'" alt="">':'<span class="duq">?</span>'),'duSlot('+JSON.stringify(slot)+')','duslot'+(DU.slot===slot?' chosen':''));if(DU.slot===slot){row+='<div class="dugrid">'+duChoices(m.id,slot).map(id=>{const it=duItem(id);return btn('<img src="'+duIcon(id)+'" alt="">'+esc(it.name),'duChoose('+JSON.stringify(id)+')');}).join('')+'</div>';}return row;}).join('');
const done=m.order.every(slot=>DU.picks[slot]);s+='<div class="chips">'+btn('Check the outfit','duCheck()','launch',!done)+'</div><details class="learning"><summary>About this dress code</summary><p>'+esc(m.intro)+' '+(m.rule?esc(m.rule):'One documented ensemble for the occasion, not a rule everyone followed.')+' Illustrative pixels, not an exact reconstruction. Sources: <a class="sourcebtn" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="'+esc(m.src)+'">'+esc(m.srcLabel)+'</a>'+(m.src2?' &middot; <a class="sourcebtn" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="'+esc(m.src2)+'">'+esc(m.src2Label)+'</a>':'')+'</p></details>';}
s+='</section>';}
s+='<footer><p>'+(storageOK?'Progress saved only in this browser on this device.':'Storage unavailable. Progress lasts only while this page is open.')+'</p><small>Clothes are simplified pixel illustrations inspired by the sources linked in each mission, not exact reconstructions.</small></footer>';
document.getElementById('app').innerHTML=s;document.body.classList.toggle('playing',false);duPaintAvatar();}
const __rdu=render;render=function(){if(DU.on){duDraw();return;}__rdu();};
(function(){const s=document.createElement('style');s.textContent='.duhero{display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;margin:14px 0}.duhero canvas{width:168px;height:224px;image-rendering:pixelated;background:#10182f;border:1px solid #55518c;border-radius:14px;flex:none}.duslot{width:100%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:8px 0}.duslot img.duicon{width:48px;height:64px;image-rendering:pixelated;flex:none}.duq{font-size:22px;color:#85f0c3;font-weight:700}.dugrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin:10px 0}.dugrid button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;text-align:center;padding:10px}.dugrid img{width:60px;height:80px;image-rendering:pixelated}.dufb{display:block;margin:10px 0;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #4f6b92;background:#192641;font-size:14px}.dufb.good{border-color:#85f0c3}.dufb.bad{border-color:#d96a6a}.dufb strong{color:#bad5ff;margin-right:6px}.dustars{font-size:22px;color:#ffd76a;letter-spacing:3px}.duthumb{width:96px;height:112px;image-rendering:pixelated;display:block;margin:0 auto 10px;background:#10182f;border:1px solid #55518c;border-radius:12px}';document.head.appendChild(s);})();

const DUH={open:null};
function duHomeToggle(k){DUH.open=DUH.open===k?null:k;if(k==='games'){scopeP=true;age=null;}render();}
function duHomeRow(ic,title,sub,fn){return btn('<span class="homebtnin go"><img class="homeicon" src="'+homeIcon(ic)+'" alt=""><span><strong>'+title+'</strong><small>'+sub+'</small></span></span>',fn);}
function duHomeAcc(key,ic,title,sub){return btn('<span class="homebtnin duacc">'+(ic==='star'?'<span class="homestar" aria-hidden="true">\u2605</span>':'<img class="homeicon" src="'+homeIcon(ic)+'" alt="">')+'<span><strong>'+title+'</strong><small>'+sub+'</small></span><i class="ducaret">'+(DUH.open===key?'\u25b4':'\u25be')+'</i></span>','duHomeToggle('+JSON.stringify(key)+')');}
function duHomeHTML(){const p=pool();const ok=!!diffP;let s='<div class="duhome">';
s+=duHomeRow('trail','Time trail','Eras in order. '+eraWins.length+' / 25 collected.','goTrail()');
s+=duHomeRow('roam','Roam freely','Browse any era.','goRoam()');
s+=duHomeAcc('games','die','Games','Quiz, Match, Timeline, Clue ladder, Dress-up, Anachronist.');
if(DUH.open==='games'){s+='<div class="duopen"><p class="note">'+(ok?'Pick a game:':'Tap a level:')+'</p><div class="chips eqrow" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))">'+['Easy','Medium','Hard'].map(d=>btn(d,'diffP=true;difficulty='+JSON.stringify(d)+';render()',diffP&&difficulty===d?'chosen':'')).join('')+'</div><p class="note">'+(difficulty==='Easy'?'Primary starter: short stories and broad connections.':difficulty==='Medium'?'Secondary starter: chronology and closer choices.':'Advanced starter only. The full master\u2019s-level source and historiography bank is not yet ready.')+'</p>'
+btn('<strong>Quiz</strong><small>Read the story, find the event.</small>','screen=\'games\';start(\'Quiz\')','tile launch',p.length<3||!gOpen('Quiz',difficulty)||!ok)
+btn('<strong>Match</strong><small>Who fits the story?</small>','screen=\'games\';start(\'People match\')','tile launch',p.length<3||!gOpen('People match',difficulty)||!ok)
+btn('<strong>Timeline</strong><small>Put 3 events earliest to latest.</small>','screen=\'games\';start(\'Timeline\')','tile launch',p.length<3||!gOpen('Timeline',difficulty)||!ok)
+btn('<strong>Clue ladder</strong><small>A new clue every 6 seconds. Points drop as clues appear.</small>','clOpen()','tile launch',!ok)
+btn('<strong>Dress the era</strong><small>Pick the right outfit for a time and place.</small>','duOpen()','tile launch',false)+btn('<strong>Anachronist</strong><small>Spot what does not belong in each era scene.</small>','XL.open(\'anx\')','tile launch',false)+gNote()+'</div>';}
s+=duHomeAcc('vault','star','Collectibles',cards.length+' / '+E.length+' story cards \u00b7 '+eraWins.length+' / 25 guide robots.');
if(DUH.open==='vault'){s+='<div class="duopen">'+btn('<strong>Discovery vault</strong><small>Open your saved story cards and guide robots.</small>','showVault()','tile launch')+'</div>';}
s+='<p class="note">Selected milestones, not complete world history. More regions, everyday life and source debates are being added. Country labels are modern navigation aids, not historical borders. Glossy-block robots are fictional guides inspired by time and place, not exact reconstructions of historical clothing.</p></div>';return s;}
window.addEventListener('storage',ev=>{if(ev.key==='pa.profile.v1')outfit();});render();

(function(){if(window.PAS)return;
var O=Storage.prototype.setItem;
function key(g){return 'pa.scores.'+g+'.v1'}
function rd(g){try{var o=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key(g)));return o&&typeof o==='object'?o:{}}catch(e){return{}}}
function nm(){try{var p=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pa.profile.v1'));return(p&&p.name)||'Guest'}catch(e){return'Guest'}}
function esc(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return{'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]})}
var PAS={game:'game',
 add:function(id,label,score,unit,low,note){if(typeof score!=='number'||!isFinite(score))return;var o=rd(PAS.game),a=o[id]||{l:label,u:unit||'pts',low:!!low,r:[]};a.l=label;a.r.push({n:nm(),s:score,d:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),x:note||''});a.r.sort(function(x,y){return a.low?x.s-y.s:y.s-x.s});a.r=a.r.slice(0,10);o[id]=a;try{O.call(localStorage,key(PAS.game),JSON.stringify(o))}catch(e){}},
 html:function(){var o=rd(PAS.game),ks=Object.keys(o).sort();var h='<p class="pas-note">Best scores, saved only on this device. ('+esc(r.x)+')':'')+' <small>'+r.d+'</small></li>'}).join('')+'</ol>'});return h},
 panel:function(){var d=document.getElementById('pasPanel');if(d){d.remove();return}d=document.createElement('div');d.id='pasPanel';d.setAttribute('role','dialog');d.setAttribute('aria-label','High scores');d.style.cssText='position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999;background:#0b1020;color:#e8f0ff;overflow:auto;padding:16px;font:14px/1.4 monospace';d.innerHTML='<button id="pasClose" style="font:inherit;padding:10px 14px;border:2px solid #5ee;background:#123;color:#fff;margin-bottom:12px">Close</button><h2 style="margin:0 0 8px">High scores</h2>'+PAS.html();document.body.appendChild(d);document.getElementById('pasClose').onclick=function(){d.remove()}},
 button:function(parent,label){if(!parent||parent.querySelector('.pasBtn'))return;var b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='pasBtn navbtn';b.textContent=label||'High scores';b.style.cssText='font:inherit;cursor:pointer';b.onclick=PAS.panel;parent.appendChild(b)}
};window.PAS=PAS})();

PAS.game='timelab';
(function(){var gr=gRec;gRec=function(m,n){try{PAS.add('round|'+m+'|'+difficulty,(m==='People match'?'Match':m)+', '+difficulty+' (share right per round)',Math.round(roundRight/n*100),'%',false,roundRight+'/'+n)}catch(e){}return gr.apply(this,arguments)};
var cf=clFinish;clFinish=function(){try{PAS.add('ladder|'+CL.topic+'|'+CL.sub,'Clue ladder: '+CL.topic+(CL.sub==='ty'?' (typed)':' (pick 6)')+', points',CL.score,'pts',false,CL.found+' of '+CL.qs.length+' found')}catch(e){}return cf.apply(this,arguments)};
function duPlaceScores(){var h=document.querySelector("header.top"),app=document.getElementById("app");if(!h||!app)return;var o=h.querySelector(".pasBtn");if(o)o.remove();
[...h.querySelectorAll("button")].forEach(function(b){if(/^\u25a3 Cards/.test(b.textContent.trim()))b.remove();if(document.querySelector(".duhome")&&/Home$/.test(b.textContent.trim()))b.remove();});
var w=document.getElementById("scoresBottom");if(!w||w.parentNode!==app||w!==app.lastElementChild){if(w)w.remove();w=document.createElement("div");w.id="scoresBottom";w.style.cssText="margin:16px 0 8px";app.appendChild(w);}PAS.button(w,"Scores");var b2=w.querySelector(".pasBtn");if(b2)b2.style.cssText="font:inherit;cursor:pointer;width:100%";}
var rn=render;render=function(){var r=rn.apply(this,arguments);try{duPlaceScores()}catch(e){}return r};try{duPlaceScores()}catch(e){}})();
</script><script>
/* ---- xl-core.js ---- */
/* ===== Time Lab new games: Anachronist, Trade Winds, Fuse (preview) ===== */
window.XL=(function(){
'use strict';
var XL={on:false,game:null};
var GAMES={};
function qs(s){return document.querySelector(s)}
function ce(t,c,html){var e=document.createElement(t);if(c)e.className=c;if(html!=null)e.innerHTML=html;return e;}
function store(k,v){try{if(v===undefined)return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k)||'null');localStorage.setItem(k,JSON.stringify(v));}catch(e){return null}}
function head(title,sub){
 var nm='Time traveller';try{var p=PAProfile.load();if(p&&p.name)nm=p.name;}catch(e){}
 return '<header class="top">'+btn('◀ Games','XL.close()','navbtn')+'<a class="navbtn arcadebtn" href="../pixel-arcade/?v=history519">◀ Pixel Arcade</a></header>'
 +'<div class="brand">NEON <span>TIME LAB</span><small>'+esc(title)+'</small></div>'
 +'<div class="guide"><canvas id="avatar" width="120" height="140" aria-label="Your Arcade avatar"></canvas><div><h1>'+esc(title)+'</h1><p>'+esc(sub)+'</p><small>'+esc(nm)+' · Your shared Arcade character</small></div></div>';
}
function mount(){
 var el=document.getElementById('app');if(!el)return;
 el.innerHTML=GAMES[XL.game].render();
 if(GAMES[XL.game].after)try{GAMES[XL.game].after();}catch(e){console.error(e);}
 try{outfit();}catch(e){}
 document.body.classList.add('playing');
 scrollTo(0,0);
}
function injectMenu(){
 if(XL.on)return;
 var grid=qs('.playbar .grid');
 if(!grid||grid.querySelector('[data-xl]'))return;
 var t='';
 if(GAMES.anx)t+=btn('<strong>Anachronist</strong><small>Spot what does not belong in each era scene.</small>','XL.open(\'anx\')','tile launch');
 if(GAMES.tw)t+=btn('<strong>Trade Winds</strong><small>Buy low, sell high along the great trade routes.</small>','XL.open(\'tw\')','tile launch');
 if(GAMES.fuse)t+=btn('<strong>Fuse</strong><small>Connect the causes that lit history\'s powder kegs.</small>','XL.open(\'fuse\')','tile launch');
 if(GAMES.dash)t+=btn('<strong>Era Rush</strong><small>Run, jump and throw through all 25 periods.</small>','XL.open(\'dash\')','tile launch');
 if(!t)return;
 grid.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<span data-xl="1" style="display:contents">'+t+'</span>');
}
XL.open=function(g){if(!GAMES[g])return;XL.on=true;XL.game=g;if(GAMES[g].open)GAMES[g].open();render();};
XL.close=function(){if(XL.game&&GAMES[XL.game].close)try{GAMES[XL.game].close();}catch(e){}XL.on=false;XL.game=null;try{goGames();}catch(e){library();}};
XL.reg=function(g,obj){GAMES[g]=obj;};
XL.store=store;XL.head=head;
var _render=render;
render=function(){
 if(XL.on){try{mount();}catch(e){console.error(e);}return;}
 var r=_render.apply(this,arguments);
 try{injectMenu();}catch(e){}
 return r;
};
/* shared pixel-icon renderer: rows of chars, each char a colour key */
XL.icon=function(def,px){
 px=px||3;var rows=def.g,w=0,i;for(i=0;i<rows.length;i++)w=Math.max(w,rows[i].length);
 var s='<svg class="xlicon" viewBox="0 0 '+w+' '+rows.length+'" width="'+(w*px)+'" height="'+(rows.length*px)+'" aria-hidden="true">';
 for(var y=0;y<rows.length;y++)for(var x=0;x<rows[y].length;x++){var ch=rows[y][x];if(ch==='.'||ch===' ')continue;var c=def.c[ch]||'#8df';s+='<rect x="'+x+'" y="'+y+'" width="1.02" height="1.02" fill="'+c+'"/>';}
 return s+'</svg>';
};
return XL;
})();

/* ---- xl-style.js ---- */
/* Styles for Anachronist, Fuse stages (Trade Winds reuses app classes). */
(function(){
var css=''
+'.neon .anxstage{position:relative;border:2px solid #26366e;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#0a1230;margin:12px 0}'
+'.neon .anxscene{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;image-rendering:auto}'
+'.neon .anxitem{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:rgba(10,18,48,.0);border:none;padding:0;cursor:pointer;width:13%;aspect-ratio:1}'
+'.neon .anxitem img{width:100%;height:100%;image-rendering:pixelated;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.7))}'
+'.neon .anxitem:hover{outline:2px dashed #5ef2c8;outline-offset:2px;border-radius:8px}'
+'.neon .anxitem.found{outline:2px solid #5ef2c8;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(94,242,200,.18)}'
+'.neon .anxitem.decoyhit{animation:anxshake .4s}'
+'@keyframes anxshake{25%{transform:translate(-58%,-50%)}75%{transform:translate(-42%,-50%)}}'
+'.neon .fusestage{position:relative;height:400px;border:2px solid #26366e;border-radius:12px;background:#0a1230;margin:12px 0;overflow:hidden}'
+'.neon .fuselines{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none}'
+'.neon .fuselines line{stroke:#5ef2c8;stroke-width:1.2;stroke-linecap:round;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 3px #5ef2c8)}'
+'.neon .fusenode{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:38%;max-width:44%;background:#141f4d;color:#e8f4ff;border:1px solid #3a53a0;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.3;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;white-space:normal;word-wrap:break-word}'
+'.neon .fusenode:hover{border-color:#5ef2c8}'
+'.neon .fusenode.sel{border-color:#ffe066;background:#1c2f63;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,224,102,.5)}'
+'.neon .fusenode.done{border-color:#5ef2c8;background:#12305a}'
+'.neon .twprofit{color:#5ef2c8}'
+'.neon .twloss{color:#ff9b6a}'
+'';
var st=document.createElement('style');st.setAttribute('data-xl','style');st.textContent=css;document.head.appendChild(st);
})();

/* ---- xl-anxart.js ---- */
/* Generated era scenes for Anachronist (webp data URIs, 2x pixel detail). */
window.ANXART=[
"data:image/webp;base64,",
